legacy_columns.name: Architecture Description
legacy_columns.note: Source-grounded synthesis is available if review/prior-work status remains explicit.

disagreement_records.proposed: Review-level architecture: visual stimuli are encoded into neuronal responses and decoded back into scenes using biophysical models, CNNs, spike-image converters, image autoencoders and probabilistic/spiking-network approaches. An integrated hypercircuit combining feedforward, recurrent and winner-take-all motifs is future work, not an implemented world simulator or evaluated controller.
disagreement_records.reason: Source-grounded synthesis is available if review/prior-work status remains explicit.

legacy_columns.name: Main Contribution
legacy_columns.note: Explicit author contribution.

disagreement_records.proposed: Reviews feature-based and sampling-based retinal visual computation and proposes a hypercircuit perspective combining diverse motifs for future neuroprosthesis algorithms.

legacy_columns.name: Key Findings
legacy_columns.note: Raw source cell retained; interpretations and disagreements are in the review. Workbook unchanged.

legacy_columns.name: Authors Reported Limitations
legacy_columns.note: Explicitly discussed limitations, despite no separately headed Limitations section.

disagreement_records.proposed: Gap-junction function and cooperation among motifs remain unresolved; natural-scene coding, model interpretation, generalization and transfer remain challenging; sampling-model learning lacks biological flexibility. Hardware, power, communications and materials are outside the principal computational scope.
disagreement_records.reason: Explicitly discussed limitations, despite no separately headed Limitations section.

legacy_columns.name: Authors Reported Future Work
legacy_columns.note: Stated future directions, not implementation.

disagreement_records.proposed: Combine feature-based/sampling-based approaches and multiple motifs in hybrid/hypercircuit networks; improve retinal encoding/decoding; explore other visual systems and neuromorphic/event-based devices.

legacy_columns.name: Research Gap Claimed by Authors
legacy_columns.note: Stated motivating gap.

disagreement_records.proposed: Limited prosthesis algorithms and incomplete understanding of complex natural-scene retinal encoding motivate better computational encoding and decoding alongside hardware advances.

legacy_columns.name: Evidence boundary (what is NOT shown)
legacy_columns.note: Required reviewer evidence-boundary synthesis.

disagreement_records.proposed: No original implemented healthcare world model, future-state rollout, action-conditioned transition, identified stimulation effect, working optimizer, calibration result or prospective patient benefit is established. Adapted figures and prior decoder [76] do not validate the proposed integrated framework.

scope_choices: Automated model review, not independent human verification or replication. Entailment-reviewed denotes comparison with the supplied source in context.
All 15 text pages were inspected in this synthesis. Image coverage comes from earlier API calls receiving text and rendered page images; this synthesis received their notes, not images directly.
Path, binary availability, page count and exact hash are supplied registry facts, not independently checked or recomputed here.
The 13 January 2020 arXiv imprint and January 14, 2020 manuscript footer are both preserved; their chronology was not independently reconciled.
The printed title says Towards; the registry title and filename say Toward.
Figures 3 and 5 are adapted from cited sources. Figure 4 describes prior decoder work [76]. Neither those primary studies nor linked data/examples were retrieved.

The proposed integrated framework has insufficient operational detail for the 127 features coded not_reported. These dispositions do not deny mechanisms in the cited literature or prove that future implementations cannot include them.
No original fully qualified numerical prediction, decision, calibration, efficiency or clinical-utility result is extracted.
No held-out actual human/clinical validation design is established for this contribution. Animal examples, synthetic illustrations and cited human studies or trials do not establish R2.
R0 applies only to the explicit future integrated proposal; it is not assigned automatically to the survey as a whole. Legacy ET is unchanged.
No original model version, implemented module or system composition is instantiated. Blueprint relevance is not implementation evidence.
No original world type is assigned. Multiple retinal cell types and circuit layers do not establish a coupled multiscale world model.
Biological milliseconds, the one-second raster, width 512 and sensor specifications in reference titles are not original forecast horizons or runtime metrics.
Bibliographic anomalies are preserved for checking, not silently corrected. No executable schema validation, semantic-validator run, graph rebuild or file write was performed.
Raw legacy cells, including historical audit identities, dates, quotation counts and synthesis, are preserved rather than endorsed as current verification.
